prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic Paris street-cafe travel portrait with relaxed luxury styling, preserving the Eiffel Tower view, white structured outfit and afternoon daylight.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with dark hair styled in a relaxed elegant updo with loose strands, wearing black oval sunglasses and a structured white short-sleeve mini dress with square neckline and large white buttons. She wears a silver decorative brooch, silver wrist accessory and small rings, and makes a gentle blowing-kiss gesture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 portrait at a round Parisian cafe table, seated with legs crossed and body slightly angled toward camera. Include a black quilted handbag with supplied hardware, wine glass, white napkins, striped awning, parked cars, classic Haussmann buildings and the Eiffel Tower centered in the distant street view. Preserve any supplied cafe signage as background typography only.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft afternoon daylight under a blue sky with scattered clouds, gentle shadows and realistic highlights on white fabric, stone buildings and tableware. Keep the mood chic, cosmopolitan, relaxed and travel-oriented.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 vertical high-end lifestyle photograph, 35–50mm lens, f/2.8–f/4 look, sharp subject and immediate foreground, softly blurred distant context, high-fidelity fabric, leather, stone and glass texture, natural color.
